ca971ea08a9727.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the education and skilling initiatives announced in January 2026?
o: ONGC and NSTFDC signed an MoU for ₹28 crore CSR support to Eklavya Model Residential Schools
NITI Aayog and NIIT Foundation targeted digital literacy for about 1.2 lakh people, at least 40% women
Simplilearn and the IndiaAI Mission targeted about 1 crore citizens through “Yuva AI for All”
Rajasthan made at least 20 minutes of daily newspaper reading mandatory in government schools
ca971ea08a9727.x: Rajasthan prescribed at least 10 minutes, not 20 minutes, of daily newspaper reading. The other three statements are correct.

ca977e186e41c3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the adolescent mental-health concern in India?
o: The issue was triggered by the deaths of three adolescent girls in Ghaziabad
WHO guidelines of 2019 recommended excessive screen exposure
The National Mental Health Survey indicated 7–10% of adolescents have diagnosable conditions
The National Mental Health Survey indicated 5–7% of school children have ADHD
ca977e186e41c3.x: The 2019 WHO guidelines warned against excessive screen exposure; they did not recommend it.

ca001ebabfd1c9.s: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding antimicrobial-resistance terms?
o: Schedule H1 – red vertical line on antibiotic strips
NDM-1 – New Delhi Metallo-β-lactamase causing resistance to β-lactams including carbapenems
ICMR-AMRSN – AMR surveillance network established in 2013
Red Line Campaign – red vertical line on antibiotic strips
ca001ebabfd1c9.x: Schedule H1 requires select antibiotics to be sold only on prescription with a register kept; the red vertical line belongs to the Red Line Campaign.

ca0b8a69ead669.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: facts carry no dates)
ca0b8a69ead669.s: Cervical cancer is the ____ most common cancer among Indian women.
ca0b8a69ead669.x: Cervical cancer is the second most common cancer among Indian women, with about 80,000 cases and over 42,000 deaths a year.

ca7f890df0db05.s: Jeevika, an institutional model linked to DAY-NRLM, is associated with which State?
ca7f890df0db05.x: Jeevika is Bihar's model; Kudumbashree is associated with Kerala.

ca29dcc5b3ddc1.s: Through which body was the vaccine for India's nationwide HPV vaccination programme procured?
ca29dcc5b3ddc1.x: The HPV vaccine for the programme was procured through Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance.

cacae6f79484ef.s: Under NAP-AMR 2.0, inter-sectoral supervision through a Coordination & Monitoring Committee is provided under:
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
cacae6f79484ef.x: NAP-AMR 2.0 places inter-sectoral supervision under NITI Aayog through a Coordination & Monitoring Committee.

caed7bfd9653c8.s: What is the eligible joining age under the Atal Pension Yojana?
caed7bfd9653c8.x: Subscribers can join the Atal Pension Yojana between 18 and 40 years of age.

ca9c6d583a6db8.s: On which platform is vaccination under the free nationwide HPV vaccination programme tracked?
ca9c6d583a6db8.x: HPV vaccination is given at government facilities and tracked on U-WIN.

ca863d3d5d26a1.s: Under the August 2024 benchmark linked to ULLAS, what literacy level is treated as 100% “fully literate”?
ca863d3d5d26a1.x: The August 2024 benchmark treats 95% literacy as 100% fully literate.

ca18a82316b29b.s: The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana was launched under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao on:
ca18a82316b29b.x: The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana was launched on 22 January 2015 under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao.

cae83572032471.s: How many new All India Institutes of Ayurveda were provided for in the AYUSH measures for 2026–27?
cae83572032471.x: Three new All India Institutes of Ayurveda were provided for.

ca5484d9ee4d58.s: How many days of guaranteed employment does VB-G RAM G provide?
ca5484d9ee4d58.x: VB-G RAM G provides 125 guaranteed days of employment.

ca2a29ff494c09.s: The Ministry of AYUSH was set up in:
ca2a29ff494c09.x: The Ministry of AYUSH was set up in 2014.

ca7ffd73842e6c.s: The Union Cabinet extended the Atal Pension Yojana till:
ca7ffd73842e6c.x: The Cabinet extended the Atal Pension Yojana till FY 2030–31; it then had 8.66 crore subscribers.

ca01364f1bbdba.s: What is the fatality rate of Kyasanur Forest Disease?
ca01364f1bbdba.x: Kyasanur Forest Disease has a fatality rate of 5–10%; there is no antiviral treatment, but a vaccine is available.

ca2d07970dd615.s: Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans under VB-G RAM G are integrated with:
ca2d07970dd615.x: Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans cover water security, rural and livelihood infrastructure and extreme-weather mitigation, and are integrated with PM Gati Shakti.

ca7a000122ac29.s: Under the India–EU FTA, AYUSH wellness centres are envisaged across how many EU states?
ca7a000122ac29.x: Wellness centres are envisaged across 27 EU states, and AYUSH practitioners may practise there with Indian qualifications.

ca3f96ece14f81.s: Which State refused to join ULLAS and runs its own Akshar Anchal scheme?
ca3f96ece14f81.x: Bihar did not join ULLAS and runs the Akshar Anchal scheme for Dalits, Mahadalits, minorities, EBCs and women aged 15–45.

cad50d5343f6ef.s: The Pankhudi portal, launched on 8 January 2026, is an initiative of which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Women and Child Development
cad50d5343f6ef.x: The Ministry of Women and Child Development launched the Pankhudi portal on 8 January 2026.

cae0074bc82970.s: The “Badhna Hai Toh Yahan Judna Hai” campaign was launched at the AI Impact Summit on 22 February 2026 by:
cae0074bc82970.x: Jayant Chaudhary launched the campaign on 22 February 2026 at the AI Impact Summit.

ca24732d24d137.s: As per NFHS-5, what share of women aged 20–24 had married before 18?
ca24732d24d137.x: NFHS-5 reported that 23% of women aged 20–24 had married before attaining 18.

cabdeafbded868.s: As an AMR-control measure, India banned colistin in:
cabdeafbded868.x: The colistin ban applied to animal feed, not to human prescription medicines.

cafecdbb7ee853.s: NAP-AMR 2.0 treats human, animal and environmental health as interlinked. This is known as the:
cafecdbb7ee853.x: NAP-AMR 2.0 follows the One Health approach, which recognises that human, animal and environmental health are interlinked.

ca5ab4d3c1c351.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the February 2026 RBI monetary policy decision?
o: The collateral-free loan limit for micro and small enterprises was raised from ₹10 lakh to ₹30 lakh
The cumulative repo-rate cut since February 2025 was 125 basis points
The current-year GDP estimate was revised from 7.3% to 7.4%
The inflation estimate was revised from 2.1% to about 3.2%
ca5ab4d3c1c351.x: The collateral-free loan limit was raised from ₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh, not ₹30 lakh.

ca3228a6129c4f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about taxation measures in the Union Budget 2026–27?
o: The New Income Tax Act, 2025 will be effective from April 2026
TCS on overseas tour packages and specified LRS education and medical remittances is cut to 5%
A one-time 6-month foreign asset disclosure scheme is proposed
The cooperative deduction is extended to cattle feed and cotton seed
ca3228a6129c4f.x: The TCS rate on these items is cut to 2%, not 5%.

ca03a6a1bdd03b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Urban Challenge Fund?
o: It has a corpus of ₹1 lakh crore and is expected to generate ₹4 lakh crore investment in 5 years
It follows a challenge-mode approach with verticals such as Cities as Growth Hubs
The Centre, States and the market contribute 50%, 25% and 25% respectively
Its period is FY 2025–26 to FY 2030–31, extendable to FY 2033–34
ca03a6a1bdd03b.x: The shares are Centre 25%, States 25% and market 50%, not 50%, 25% and 25%.

caa6f9e702b8fa.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the infrastructure and energy developments reported in January 2026?
o: The old Pamban bridge was opened in 1914 and is about 2.3 km long
Coking coal was declared a critical and strategic mineral under the MMDR Act, 1957
The India Post MoUs for national rural logistics were signed on 7 January 2026
Vehicle-to-vehicle communication needs a mobile network or internet to function
caa6f9e702b8fa.x: V2V communication is designed to work without a mobile network or internet connection.

ca8473afe0605d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the macroeconomic worries highlighted in Budget 2026?
o: Nominal GDP growth was about 8%, against 10.1% assumed in the February 2025 Budget
Private corporate investment stayed weak despite corporate tax cuts, capex and PLI
Weak tax buoyancy means tax grows faster than GDP
Actual tax buoyancy was 0.6, against 1.1 assumed
ca8473afe0605d.x: Weak buoyancy means tax grows slower than GDP, not faster.

cab66d8851e44e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Startup India initiatives?
o: MeitY Startup Hub covers more than 6,148 startups and 517 incubators
ASPIRE is a Department of Science and Technology scheme
PMEGP supports projects up to ₹50 lakh in manufacturing and ₹20 lakh in services
The States' Startup Ranking Framework includes Best Performers and Emerging Ecosystems
cab66d8851e44e.x: ASPIRE is a Ministry of MSME initiative for livelihood business incubators, not a DST scheme.

ca4074ff186311.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the biofuel initiatives reviewed by the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas?
o: SATAT had more than 130 CBG plants by November 2025
Mandatory CBG blending in CNG and PNG was introduced from FY 2025–26
Ethanol blending saved ₹1.55 lakh crore in forex
ca4074ff186311.x: The 19.24% ethanol-blending figure relates to ESY 2024–25, not ESY 2025–26.

ca77f254f5777b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the NPS Swasthya Pension Scheme pilot?
o: If inpatient costs exceed 70% of the corpus, withdrawal is limited to 70% of the corpus
Non-government subscribers above 40 can transfer up to 30% of their NPS contributions
Medical withdrawals are allowed up to 25% of the subscriber's own contribution
If inpatient costs exceed 70% of the corpus, up to 100% can be withdrawn
ca77f254f5777b.x: When inpatient costs exceed 70% of the corpus, withdrawal of up to 100%, not 70%, is permitted.

caa9ed4de93fff.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: facts carry no dates)
caa9ed4de93fff.s: GENESIS, a deep-tech startup platform with ₹490 crore for 5 years, belongs to:
caa9ed4de93fff.x: GENESIS is MeitY's deep-tech platform with ₹490 crore over 5 years and a target of 1,600 startups.

caa8c521dae7d1.s: India's first National UAV Test and Innovation Corridor is at Rangeilunda Airport in which State?
caa8c521dae7d1.x: The corridor is at Rangeilunda Airport in Ganjam, Odisha.

ca57e8214515e0.s: Which MSME scheme is a World Bank-supported Central Sector Scheme?
ca57e8214515e0.x: RAMP is the World Bank-supported Central Sector Scheme; PMEGP is a margin money subsidy, CGTMSE a credit guarantee and MSE-CDP a cluster scheme.

ca787a260e0bc7.s: India's aviation sector provides 7.7 million jobs and accounts for about ____ of GDP.
ca787a260e0bc7.x: Aviation provides 7.7 million jobs and contributes 1.5% of GDP.

n750517f8290.s: Under the revised FDTL norms, weekly rest for flight crew was increased from 36 hours to:
n750517f8290.x: The revised FDTL norms raise weekly rest from 36 to 48 hours.

ca764f0961eee5.s: As of 15 January of the 2025–26 season, India's total sugar production stood at:
ca764f0961eee5.x: Production was 15.9 million tonnes, with 518 mills operating.

ca7bcef287a4f9.s: Which policy was India's first integrated aviation policy and replaced the 5/20 rule with 0/20?
ca7bcef287a4f9.x: NCAP 2016 was the first integrated aviation policy and replaced the 5/20 rule with 0/20.

cafffb2fc42082.s: The World Bank-supported RAMP programme for MSMEs stands for:
cafffb2fc42082.x: RAMP stands for Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance; it covers 2022–23 to 2026–27.

ca378177a716c8.s: Who presented the first Budget of independent India on 26 November 1947?
ca378177a716c8.x: R.K. Shanmukham Chetty presented the first Budget of independent India on 26 November 1947.

caca5326e0c011.s: How many new routes did UDAN add in 2024?

ca7f09f2b5c9c1.s: Budget 2026–27 proposes a National Institute of Hospitality by upgrading:
o: Indian Institute of Tourism and Travel Management
Indian Institute of Skiing and Mountaineering
ca7f09f2b5c9c1.x: The National Institute of Hospitality is to be created by upgrading NCHMCT.

ca2109e666e275.s: What is the outlay of Biopharma Shakti announced in the Union Budget 2026–27?
ca2109e666e275.x: Biopharma Shakti has an outlay of ₹10,000 crore over 5 years.

ca3f3c33522389.s: GST collections in January 2026 amounted to:
ca3f3c33522389.x: January 2026 GST collections were ₹1.93 lakh crore, up 6.2%.

cab4acf303dce3.s: Bharat-VISTAAR is a multilingual AI platform integrating AgriStack with the practices of:
cab4acf303dce3.x: Bharat-VISTAAR integrates AgriStack with ICAR practices.

n356ce873523.s: In share of world GDP during 1980–2023, which country ranked third?
n356ce873523.x: Germany (4.29%) ranked third, ahead of Japan (4.0%); India (3.45%) was fifth.

ca84ccfb8528a4.x: The Kharif 2025 Digital Crop Survey covered 604 districts and more than 28.5 crore plots.

ca8d0425426dcd.s: Sonepur International Airport, with a 4,200-metre runway for A380 aircraft, is in which district of Bihar?
ca8d0425426dcd.x: Sonepur International Airport is in Saran, Bihar.

cae9fb1a678c47.s: During 2014–15 to 2024–25, Indian agriculture grew at about ____ per year, the highest ever.
cae9fb1a678c47.x: Agriculture grew at 4.45% per year during 2014–15 to 2024–25.

n3860e99f08d.s: As per BAHS 2023, Andhra Pradesh ranked ____ in State-wise milk production with a 6.70% share.
n3860e99f08d.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked fifth (6.70%) after Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat.

nb19204303da.s: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 replaces the:
nb19204303da.x: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 replaces the Aircraft Act, 1934.

ca313272d5909c.s: Around what share of registered MSME units in India are micro or small?
ca313272d5909c.x: Around 95% of registered MSME units are micro or small.

n281ed0dbf3d.s: The first paperless Union Budget of India was presented for:
n281ed0dbf3d.x: The first paperless Union Budget was for 2021–22.

ca003932954931.s: The Budget Estimate for fiscal deficit in 2026–27 is:
ca003932954931.x: The 2026–27 Budget Estimate places the fiscal deficit at 4.3% of GDP; 4.4% is the earlier figure.

n8787f5b928a.s: The Atal Innovation Mission was launched by NITI Aayog in:
n8787f5b928a.x: AIM was launched by NITI Aayog in 2016.

n8900e9bf31c.s: The Economic Survey 2025–26 was prepared by:
o: Economic Division, Department of Economic Affairs
n8900e9bf31c.x: The Survey is prepared by the Economic Division of the Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance.

ca57aa10f2ef70.s: International MSME Day, designated by the UN General Assembly in 2017, is observed on:
ca57aa10f2ef70.x: International MSME Day is observed on 27 June.

ca3525ed63b1ed.s: The Indian rupee has full convertibility on:
ca3525ed63b1ed.x: The rupee has full current account convertibility but only partial capital account convertibility.

ca52c23c626bed.s: Under PMUY, the ₹300 subsidy (up to nine refills a year) applies to which cylinder?
ca52c23c626bed.x: The ₹300 subsidy applies to the 14.2 kg cylinder, for up to nine refills a year.

ca6702b94f09d7.s: The Economic Survey 2025–26 estimated GDP growth for 2025–26 at:
ca6702b94f09d7.x: GDP growth for 2025–26 was estimated at 7.4%; the 2026–27 projection was 6.8–7.2%.

ca775c72b2366d.s: MSMEs account for approximately what share of India's GDP?
ca775c72b2366d.x: MSMEs contribute about 30.1% of GDP; 35.4% is manufacturing output, 45.73% exports and 62% employment.

ca552bfdf786ab.s: Cyber Jagrit Bharat for MSMEs was conducted with:
ca552bfdf786ab.x: Cyber Jagrit Bharat was conducted with CERT-In, not the World Bank.

ca9b981e51196f.s: Real GDP growth for Q3 (October–December) of 2025–26 was:
ca9b981e51196f.x: Q3 growth was 7.8%, against 7.4% a year earlier.

caae7cf3c6013c.s: Foodgrain production in 2024–25 reached a record:
caae7cf3c6013c.x: Foodgrain production in 2024–25 reached a record 3,577.32 lakh tonnes.

ca64e40f002a7c.s: Under Schedule VI of the Fertiliser Control Order, 1985, biostimulants are divided into how many categories?
ca64e40f002a7c.x: Biostimulants have nine categories under Schedule VI, introduced in February 2021.

ca61e322c412e7.s: Cooperative banks were brought under RBI control by the:

ca3b4caa8f3906.s: Kisan Credit Card coverage reached about:
ca3b4caa8f3906.x: KCC coverage was 7.75 crore farmers, not 7.75 lakh.

caf864ba11f72b.s: DISCOMs recorded their first-ever profit in 2024–25 of:
caf864ba11f72b.x: DISCOMs recorded a first-ever profit of ₹2,701 crore in 2024–25.

ca6ab87a5676a2.s: Rice is a staple food for about what share of Indians?
ca6ab87a5676a2.x: Rice is a staple for about 65% of Indians; it covers about 25% of the total cropped area.

ca0f2ae296fcf9.s: As per the Economic Survey 2025–26, Andhra Pradesh's inflation declined from 7.57% to:
ca0f2ae296fcf9.x: Andhra Pradesh's inflation fell from 7.57% to 1.39%; national retail inflation was 1.7% in April–December.

cae476ee8f237c.s: Bitcoin Cash emerged through a hard fork of Bitcoin in:
cae476ee8f237c.x: The Bitcoin Cash hard fork occurred in 2017.

cae2c7d4121cea.x: India produced 239.3 MMT of milk in 2023–24 and was the world's largest milk producer.

ca5770d5966fb3.s: The World Bank projected India's GDP growth for 2025–26 at:
ca5770d5966fb3.x: The World Bank projected 7.2% growth for 2025–26, while the NSO's first advance estimate was 7.4%.

ca61537f241521.s: The PAIMANA portal replaced the Online Monitoring System introduced in:
ca61537f241521.x: PAIMANA replaced the 2006 Online Monitoring System, follows “one data, one entry” and automates about 60% of updates.

caeb5f41d02254.s: Which investor-education campaign was suggested along with the National Strategy for Financial Education?
caeb5f41d02254.x: The campaign was Mutual Fund Sahi Hai, suggested along with the National Strategy for Financial Education.

ca4985823d2a5a.s: SAKSHAM 2026 (Samrakshan Kshamata Mahotsav), held from 2–16 February 2026, was organised by the:
o: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
ca4985823d2a5a.x: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas organised SAKSHAM 2026 with the theme “Conserve Oil and Natural Gas – Towards a Greener Future”.

ca7e04e7c81127.s: Under the 2020 composite MSME criteria, the turnover limit for a medium enterprise was:
ca7e04e7c81127.x: The 2020 criteria use investment and turnover together; a medium enterprise had limits of ₹50 crore investment and ₹250 crore turnover.

ca3e371c408302.s: The threshold for “substantial interest” was raised from ₹5 lakh to:
ca3e371c408302.x: The “substantial interest” threshold was raised from ₹5 lakh to ₹2 crore.

cacbe07c8e273d.s: The Union Budget 2026–27 proposes a second ____ and upgrades institutes at Ranchi and Tezpur as regional apex institutions.
cacbe07c8e273d.x: The Budget proposes a second NIMHANS, with Ranchi and Tezpur institutes upgraded as regional apex institutions.

ca6c81f8fe2ce2.s: The Union Budget 2026–27 was structured around three:
ca6c81f8fe2ce2.x: The Budget was built around three Kartavya: growth, aspirations and capacity, and access for every family, community, region and sector.

ca25cdc68e8976.s: SBI Research projected that India's per capita income would reach ____ by 2030, giving it upper-middle-income status.
ca25cdc68e8976.x: SBI Research projected per capita income of USD 4,000 by 2030, linked to upper-middle-income status under the World Bank classification.

ca40727013adce.s: The Chief Economic Adviser projected India's growth for 2026–27 in the range of:
ca40727013adce.x: The CEA projected 7–7.4% growth for 2026–27 and said the economy may cross USD 4 trillion.

ca7e67ea391c2a.s: The Unified Pipeline Tariff, based on “One Nation, One Grid, One Tariff”, has applied from:
ca7e67ea391c2a.x: The Unified Pipeline Tariff has applied from 1 April 2023 and covers about 90% of pipelines.

ca300d1e0b56c0.s: IOCL, the first Indian company with ISCC CORSIA certification for Sustainable Aviation Fuel, obtained it for which refinery?
ca300d1e0b56c0.x: The certification was for IOCL's Panipat refinery.

ca6d5803a0faaa.s: NTPC's coal-to-SNG project is at Talaipalli in which State?
ca6d5803a0faaa.x: NTPC's coal-to-SNG project is at Talaipalli, Chhattisgarh.

cabb932c7fac2c.s: The revised FDTL rules for flight crew were aligned with the standards of:
cabb932c7fac2c.x: The revised Flight Duty Time Limitation rules were aligned with ICAO standards.

cab9126920a198.s: India's trade deficit with China reached a record ____ in 2025.
cab9126920a198.x: The deficit hit a record USD 116.12 billion in 2025, up from USD 99.21 billion in 2024.

ca876d02514649.s: Under the SARFAESI Act, 2002, InvITs are recognised as:
ca876d02514649.x: InvITs are recognised as borrowers under the SARFAESI Act, 2002.

ca43cec545fdcd.s: Bitcoin fell below $85,000 after reaching a record of about ____ in October 2025.
ca43cec545fdcd.x: Bitcoin's October 2025 record was $126,000; sales of 800,000 Bitcoins by long-term holders within a month were cited for the fall.

ca91b4aa49a546.s: SBI CHAKRA is an SBI Centre of Excellence for financing how many sunrise sectors?
ca91b4aa49a546.x: SBI CHAKRA is meant for financing 8 sunrise sectors.

ca535a15032e74.s: The Fund of Funds for Startups, with a corpus of ₹10,000 crore, is associated with:
ca535a15032e74.x: The Fund of Funds for Startups is associated with SIDBI; NCGTC handles the Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups.

ca6617fb3b8d79.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the labour and trade outcomes of PM Modi's visit to Israel?
o: The worker target was set for a period of ten years
A bilateral investment agreement was concluded in 2025
Free Trade Agreement talks were to be accelerated
ca6617fb3b8d79.x: The target of 50,000 more Indian workers was for five years, not ten.

ca9534a88e4b01.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's Digital Public Infrastructure outreach?
o: India signed DPI or India Stack MoUs with 23 countries
DigiLocker pacts covered Cuba, Kenya, the UAE and Lao PDR
The India Stack Global Portal offered 18 platforms
ca9534a88e4b01.x: UPI was available in eight countries, not 23; 23 is the number of countries with DPI or India Stack MoUs.

cad78de18a3d66.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the January 2026 US action in Venezuela?
o: Nicolás Maduro was first taken to the USS Iwo Jima
Maduro was detained in New York on narco-terrorism charges
Delcy Rodríguez was sworn in as Interim President after being named by Venezuelan courts
Venezuela described the action as a lawful extradition

ca163f3ab05399.s: Venezuela possesses approximately how many barrels of proven crude oil reserves?
ca163f3ab05399.x: Venezuela has approximately 300 billion barrels of proven crude reserves.

ca2afe85995a64.s: India signed the “Action Plan for Prioritization and Implementation of Cooperation Areas in the Nuclear Field” with Russia through:
ca2afe85995a64.x: The nuclear-field Action Plan was signed with Russia through Rosatom.

ca8e919816eff3.s: During Operation Swadesh, about how many Indian medical students were estimated to be in Iran?
ca8e919816eff3.x: Around 10,000 Indians were in Iran, including 2,500–3,000 medical students.

ca79d58bbe4067.s: At the time of the India–Nepal Mutual Legal Assistance Treaty on criminal matters, Nepal's Prime Minister was:
ca79d58bbe4067.x: Sushila Karki is Nepal's Prime Minister; Ram Chandra Poudel is the President.

cae91f93dfaa1f.x: India offered tariff relief on 95% of New Zealand imports, 57% duty-free from day one; New Zealand gave zero duty on 100% of Indian exports.

n6d1fbe4d52e.s: India–Russia ties were upgraded to a “Special and Privileged Strategic Partnership” in:
n6d1fbe4d52e.x: The upgrade came in 2010; 2000 saw the Declaration on Strategic Partnership.

ca67c9c1f52815.s: India and the UAE have set a target of USD 200 billion in bilateral trade by:
ca67c9c1f52815.x: The India–UAE bilateral trade target is USD 200 billion by 2032.

n8610991bf10.s: The Monroe Doctrine, invoked by the United States over Venezuela, dates back to:
n8610991bf10.x: The Monroe Doctrine was enunciated in 1823.

cafebef2788696.s: BrahMos is named after the Brahmaputra and the ____ rivers.
cafebef2788696.x: BrahMos takes its name from the Brahmaputra and Moskva rivers.

n4dffaa868eb.s: SAGAR (2015), India's maritime vision for the Indian Ocean Region, stands for:
o: Safety and Growth Across the Region
Security and Governance for All in the Region
Security and Growth for All in the Region
Sustainable Growth for All in the Region
n4dffaa868eb.x: SAGAR stands for Security and Growth for All in the Region and casts India as a net security provider in the IOR.

caaa41f414202d.s: Piton de la Fournaise, a basaltic shield volcano in the news, is located on:
caaa41f414202d.x: Piton de la Fournaise is a basaltic shield volcano on Réunion Island.

ca490f99c7071a.s: Under the four-bin colour coding of the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026, the red bin is meant for:
ca490f99c7071a.x: Green is for wet waste, blue for dry, red for sanitary and black for special-care waste.

ca86a3c1a62179.s: About how much of the Great Nicobar Island Project area was allegedly in prohibited zones under the ICRZ Notification 2019?
ca86a3c1a62179.x: About 700 ha were allegedly in ICRZ 2019 prohibited zones, alongside concerns over 130 sq km of rainforest.

ca1b47009e1d58.s: Tamil Nadu's suit against Karnataka in the Pennaiyar River dispute was filed under:
ca1b47009e1d58.x: Tamil Nadu invoked Article 131; the Supreme Court directed the Centre to set up a tribunal within one month.

cabb9a333fc8c7.s: Under the NDMA guidelines on Disaster Victim Identification, the final stage of the process is:
cabb9a333fc8c7.x: The four stages run from systematic recovery to post-mortem data, ante-mortem data and reconciliation.

ca210f998f7361.s: Under the Supreme Court's November 2025 uniform definition, only hills above what elevation are treated as Aravallis?
ca210f998f7361.x: The uniform threshold is above 100 m; fresh mining leases were paused in Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan and Gujarat.

caa62fc85d69a2.s: Anamalai Tiger Reserve, where the tiger census will use the M-STrIPES app, is located in:
caa62fc85d69a2.x: Anamalai Tiger Reserve is in Tamil Nadu, not Kerala.

ca4092e8402b54.s: Karnataka's GI products Nanjangud Rasabale banana, Mysuru betel leaves and Indi lemon were exported to:
ca4092e8402b54.x: The three Karnataka GI products were exported to Maldives.

ca3a8737abaf9e.s: The Shahpur Kandi Project was declared a national project in:
ca3a8737abaf9e.x: Shahpur Kandi became a national project in 2008, with costs shared 80% by Punjab and 20% by the Centre.

ca5eaa9cc9e25d.s: As per the DNA-based elephant population estimation for 2021–25, India's elephant population was:
ca5eaa9cc9e25d.x: The estimate was 22,446, against 29,964 in 2017, a decline of about 25%.

cadfe3ed867dda.s: Grasslands cover about what share of Earth's land?
cadfe3ed867dda.x: Grasslands cover about 40% of Earth's land, and their carbon is stored mainly in the soil.

cacfae96fb94cd.s: The frogs Leptobrachium somani and L. mechuka were recorded from which State?
cacfae96fb94cd.x: Both Leptobrachium species were recorded from Arunachal Pradesh.

ca986719ba2ee7.s: Kenis, shallow wells over 200 years old highlighted on World Wetlands Day 2026, are found in:
ca986719ba2ee7.x: Kenis are traditional shallow wells in Wayanad, Kerala.

caaf92639e9e76.s: Bioremediation can only transform or immobilise, but cannot completely degrade:
caaf92639e9e76.x: Heavy metals such as cadmium and lead cannot be completely degraded; they can only be transformed or immobilised.

caced559996d9b.s: Bomb cyclones are most frequent in:
caced559996d9b.x: Bomb cyclones occur most often in fall and winter.

ca9d4e1e9839ed.s: Ratapani Tiger Reserve lies in Raisen and ____ districts of Madhya Pradesh.
ca9d4e1e9839ed.x: Ratapani lies in Raisen and Sehore districts, with the Kolar River forming its western boundary.

ca00f4a53f0228.s: Tso Kar, a high-altitude Ramsar site, is located in:
ca00f4a53f0228.x: Tso Kar is in Ladakh, not Himachal Pradesh.

ca766e88a40e3d.s: Which tribes are associated with the Great Nicobar Island Project area?
ca766e88a40e3d.x: The Shompen and Nicobarese are the tribes associated with the project.

ca99bf094b932c.s: India targets a ____ cut in the emissions intensity of its GDP from 2005 levels by 2030.
ca99bf094b932c.x: India targets a 45% cut in emissions intensity from 2005 by 2030 and Net Zero by 2070.

ca6c8b335a0cf9.s: The Suav river, in the news, is a tributary of the:
ca6c8b335a0cf9.x: The Suav is a tributary of the Rapti, not the Pennaiyar.

cae14f0ed2fc5c.s: Spraying oil-eating bacteria on an ocean oil spill is an example of:
cae14f0ed2fc5c.x: In situ bioremediation treats pollution on the spot, as with oil-eating bacteria on a spill.

caa5b082c10a21.s: The Pangolakha range forms part of the boundary between Sikkim and:
caa5b082c10a21.x: The Pangolakha range forms part of the Sikkim–Bhutan boundary.

ca2c5cf371813a.s: The Great Nicobar Island Project, launched in 2021, was conceived by:
o: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
ca2c5cf371813a.x: The project was conceived by NITI Aayog and includes an ICTT and a greenfield international airport.

cac33f08afd985.s: The gharial (Gavialis gangeticus) of the Gandak River habitat is classified as:

ca259b29b01d49.s: Under the Paris Agreement, Nationally Determined Contributions are submitted every:

ca5e93e87df647.s: The Aravalli range is nearly how old?
ca5e93e87df647.x: The Aravallis are nearly two billion years old and extend about 650 km from Delhi to Gujarat.

ca27d93848b555.s: The scientific name of the rare galaxy frog of the Western Ghats is:
ca27d93848b555.x: The galaxy frog is Melanobatrachus indicus; it lives under rotten logs and does not use vocal calls.

ca072ce51f04ca.s: How long is the elevated corridor inaugurated in Kaziranga National Park?
ca072ce51f04ca.x: The elevated corridor is 34.5 km long; Kaziranga lies between the Brahmaputra and the Karbi Hills.

caf03daf53ed5e.s: Which country recorded 131 glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) events?
caf03daf53ed5e.x: Pakistan recorded 131 GLOF events, India 59 and Nepal 54.

ca17fc8797e9d8.s: Melghat Tiger Reserve is a stronghold of the:
ca17fc8797e9d8.x: Melghat is a stronghold of the forest owlet; Korku is its largest associated tribe.

ca97712a813862.s: How many dolphins did the Odisha Dolphin Census 2026 record?
ca97712a813862.x: The Odisha Dolphin Census 2026 recorded 765 dolphins.

n97b12c32730.s: Cyclone Ditwah, which hit Sri Lanka in late 2025, was named by:
n97b12c32730.x: Ditwah was named by Yemen; it caused more than 600 deaths.

ca461b838c74df.s: Ischaemic heart disease accounts for about what share of deaths from household air pollution?
ca461b838c74df.x: Ischaemic heart disease accounts for 32%, stroke 23% and lower respiratory infections 21%.

ca2479d77141fd.s: A Geographical Indication registration in India is valid for:
ca2479d77141fd.x: A GI registration is valid for 10 years and can be renewed indefinitely.

ca8b092ff1d515.s: The Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 mandate segregation of waste into how many streams?
ca8b092ff1d515.x: The Rules mandate four streams: wet, dry, sanitary and special-care waste.

ca115c7b00146c.s: A bomb cyclone forms when cold Arctic or Canadian air meets:
ca115c7b00146c.x: The clash of cold Arctic or Canadian air with warm, moist air drives an intense mid-latitude storm.

caae3107ca804d.s: The Jhelum, into which Dal Lake drains, originates at:
caae3107ca804d.x: The Jhelum originates at Verinag, not Srinagar.

cac16b49a6b186.s: Which of the following is identified as a driver of glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) risk?
cac16b49a6b186.x: Elevation-dependent warming drives GLOF risk; lake-terminating glaciers retreat faster, not slower.

ca5ca0aa1f2697.s: Cyclone Ditwah did not make landfall near Puducherry mainly because it:
o: weakened into a low over Sri Lanka
moved parallel to the Tamil Nadu–Puducherry coast
ca5ca0aa1f2697.x: Its movement parallel to the Tamil Nadu–Puducherry coast reduced the landfall risk.

ca59d2bb61935e.s: Butterflies engage in mud or soil puddling mainly to absorb:
ca59d2bb61935e.x: Mud puddling lets butterflies absorb minerals and salts, not nectar.

cae6988701a61b.s: The Indian Skimmer conservation project of BNHS and NMCG focuses on protecting:
cae6988701a61b.x: River sandbars are the Indian Skimmer's nesting sites.
